name: ebrovia
summary: Ebrovia reveals its character through a drawer clad in lustrous veneer, its polished surface reflecting understated sophistication. The form is framed in stainless steel with a brushed brass finish, adding warmth and radiance to its modern profile. Strong yet graceful, Ebrovia embodies refined functionality elevated into timeless design.
